postal_system.dated_shape_rule: The August 2011 UPU sheet documents three digits, with a first digit associated with one of six historical provinces and two department/Fivondronana digits. Syntax alone is not a current assignment.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Production assignment authority requires a current digest-pinned Paositra Malagasy row or issuer-approved artifact with observed_at, valid-time and approved field rights. The operator homepage self-address, UPU examples and manually collected community list do not establish a complete current register.
postal_system.administrative_transition_rule: The dated province and Fivondronana coding explanation must not be silently relabelled as a current region, district, commune or fokontany. Any historical-to-current administrative crosswalk is separately versioned, many-to-many capable and non-postal context.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed Paositra Malagasy source publishes canonical postcode boundary coordinates. Default full-code geometry is none; province, region, district, commune, fokontany, office point, buffer, Voronoi surface, model output and AGID cover are never an official postcode polygon.
postal_system.address_rule: The dated UPU format places the three-digit postcode to the left of the postal town and separates home-delivery lines from B.P./P.O. Box delivery. Its examples define format only and are not reusable live addresses or assignments.
postal_system.community_rule: The 2021 OpenStat Madagascar artifact is CC BY 4.0, manually collected online and explicitly possibly incomplete. It may be a separately attributed candidate and discrepancy source, never Paositra Malagasy authority.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a rights-cleared civic address point, matching normalized components, an explicit address-to-building relation and independently licensed building geometry. Postcode, lot text, locality, land parcel, nearest feature, containment and model score are insufficient.
postal_system.land_rule: FTM, UN SALB and MATSF administrative, cartographic, territorial and land context remain source- and product-specific. Administrative or cadastral geometry does not prove a postcode, civic address, building, title holder, owner, resident or occupant.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Madagascar Law 2014-038 requires legitimate specified purpose, proportionality, accuracy, security and bounded retention under CMIL oversight. Person-linked precise addresses, recipients, box holders, residents, owners, occupants, instructions and query histories are not public artifacts.
postal_system.realtime_rule: Live operator or agency observations become bounded normalized receipts with source URL, terms version, digest, observed_at, valid-time and parser version; there is no invisible unverified live fallback or training mirror.
postal_system.model_rule: Learned models may rank candidates, detect drift, compress indexes or propose derived surfaces. They never confer official assignment, polygon, current administrative identity, address, building or deliverability authority.
postal_system.compression_rule: A compact three-digit index, minimal perfect hash and PMTiles, FlatGeobuf or Parquet candidate layers are allowed only while exact codes, validity, historical semantics, authority, lineage, uncertainty and correction paths remain recoverable.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only digest-pinned, rights-cleared, minimized, non-personal public artifacts. Restricted geographic, land or address evidence remains on controlled infrastructure.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID is an independent spatial index and versioned crosswalk. An AGID cell or cell union is not a Paositra Malagasy assignment or polygon, historical/current administrative boundary, parcel, civic address or building.

validation_rules.pass: Every official assignment has a current Paositra Malagasy artifact, approved rights, digest, observation time and valid-time.
Every normalized code follows the reviewed three-digit rule; shape never substitutes for current assignment evidence.
Historical province/Fivondronana semantics and current administrative identities are versioned separately.
No code is published with canonical Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry without issuer-authorized boundary evidence.
Postal, administrative, land, community, address, building and AGID authority are stored separately.
Explicit rights-cleared address-building relation and matching normalized components are present.
No personal, title-holder, subscriber, recipient, occupant or query data is published and every field has approved rights.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Sources, semantics, licences and blockers inventoried.
Contract, source profile and synthetic conformance fixtures reviewable.
Rights-cleared observations reproduce a digest-pinned experimental pack.
Independent holdout, ambiguity, privacy, freshness and correction gates pass.
Two consecutive refreshes pass and rollback is monitored.
